_what: Proofs for the D187 r2 queue-register fix and the covex-v6-state-shares-r2 label. Committed as a FILE without being asked twice: the H100 made the same two requests on r1 (digests asserted only in a header, and no name proof of its own), and the right response to a reviewer asking for something reasonable once is to do it unprompted the next time.
cell: seed 4, 16 devices, 1200 s, ratio 40:40:20, lh_req, ss2, epg, per-frame, reask 30.0

THE_CHANGE.what: the release re-check's queue input is now self._w.total() (submit to FIRST TOKEN) instead of self._uncached_in_flight (submit to COMPLETION, which includes decode), at both re-check call sites; and W tracking is now UNCONDITIONAL
THE_CHANGE.why_it_is_an_implementation_bug_not_a_ch: cost_model_gate_d162.py:97 builds the fitted queue regressor as _queue_ahead over the interval (t_submit, t_submit + first_token_s), and _queue_ahead sums the weight of intervals OPEN AT THE START INSTANT. So the coefficient was estimated against submit-to-first-token work. Feeding it submit-to-completion work gives the model a LARGER quantity than its own regressor, which overestimates the predicted first token and refuses work that would have fitted. This is read from the fit's source, not inferred from behaviour.
THE_CHANGE.why_W_tracking_had_to_become_uncondition: it was gated on share admission, so an arm carrying the re-check WITHOUT share admission (covex-v6-state-shares-noadmit) would have read W as 0. That UNDERSTATES the queue, which is the UNSAFE direction, and the fix would have introduced it.

r2_name_proof._what: covex-v6-state-shares-r2 resolves through run_live2_real.py itself, with a negative control
r2_name_proof._note: through run_live2_real.py ITSELF as a subprocess with the posted knobs. The harness imports only `arms` and `hybrid`, so a name that resolves in a friendly process can still die at cell start. The negative control is not optional: without it, 'no KeyError appeared' passes trivially whenever the subprocess failed for another reason.

WHAT_THESE_PROOFS_DO_NOT_SHOW: They show the change HARMLESS. They show almost NOTHING about its SIZE. On a dry cell `on_first` never fires because there is no backend, so W drains only at settle and the two quantities nearly coincide: the very difference this fix is about is absent dry. The firing proof is the live r2 cells, against the pass check pre-registered at 3ed47764 with its failure condition, its seed-5 control and its harm bound of at most 10 late robot requests.
